column4: Windows 11 Pro 26300 arm64, osquery 5.24.1 (x64 MSI, SHA-256 matches the GitHub release digest). No JoinInfo subkeys or Entra certificates. 31 built-in Enrollments subkeys, none with MS DM Server.
Intune row equals expected intune_device_id with its enrollment key. Entra row equals expected entra_device_id; common_name and subject both hold the bare GUID.
Both queries return no rows with no fakes, next to 31 built-in Enrollments subkeys.
JoinInfo subkey with no matching certificate: Intune row only, no Entra row.
Matching subkey and certificate from a non-Entra issuer: no Entra row.
Two Intune rows, each with its enrollment key, so a stale enrollment is visible. One Entra row.
Two Entra joins with matching certificates: one row, the newer certificate's ID.

Host 35 in Device IDs Lab (Fleet 4.94.0, fleetd osquery 5.24.1): both stored reports return the faked IDs through /reports/:id/report (paged and unpaged) and /hosts/:id/reports/:id; report_clipped false; enrollment key returned. With wrong expected IDs the comparison fails on all four value checks.
